summary: The registrant, Kandal M Venture Ltd, filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, reporting a second closing of a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for an additional $1 million senior unsecured convertible note (10% interest, due June 2029, convertible at 105% of principal). This is a routine capital-raising through a registered direct offering, not a special situation. The filing merely updates disclosure for a convertible note placement exempt under Rule 506(b). No tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, activist involvement, or strategic review is indicated. This is an ordinary financing event, not an extraordinary corporate transaction.
